name: k8s factory — a pod stays Pending for more than 10 min in factory or factory-mi-homelab
description: Fires, per pod, when more than 20 k8s.pod.phase datapoints with phase 1 (Pending) arrive for a pod in factory or factory-mi-homelab within the trailing 15 min. k8s_cluster scrapes every 30 s and a pod never returns to Pending, so 21 samples is more than 10 min of continuous Pending. Emitter: k8s_cluster on the poweredge-xubuntu collector (thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml, item livespec-dev-tooling-ec2rkp). Receiver: the poweredge-xubuntu otel-collector (thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.ci-runner-host.yaml) -> Honeycomb env livespec. Runbook: open the 'Kubernetes workloads and control plane' board; kubectl get pods -n <namespace> -o wide; kubectl describe pod -n <namespace> <pod>; kubectl get events -n <namespace> --sort-by=.lastTimestamp. Read the pod's FailedScheduling event in dataset k8s-events (join on k8s.namespace.name and k8s.pod.name). Plan kubernetes-node-observability (livespec-dev-tooling-dfdiil), item livespec-dev-tooling-t6om4l.
